title: The meeting bot is already in the call
scenario: An AI note-taking bot joins your confidential client call uninvited, asking to be admitted so it can share the transcript and recording with 'the organizer' afterward.

answers.A: Admit it, since these bots are common in meetings now.
answers.B: Remove it and confirm with the actual organizer whether they added a note-taker before continuing.
answers.C: Admit it, and continue the meeting without mentioning it to anyone.

explanation: An uninvited AI meeting bot can silently record and export a confidential conversation to an outside party; its presence should be confirmed with the meeting organizer, not assumed.
proTip: Anything that can record the whole meeting deserves the same check as any other uninvited guest.
